common.attention_prefix: INT8 except BF16 dense sections; refiner and padding BF16
common.reference: E150 BF16 with matched prompt seed and initial latents
common.weights: phase-level CPU/GPU switch between BF16 and packed FP4 weights included in timings
common.rank64: SM120 CuTe DSL NVFP4 GEMM with fused low-rank up; BF16 low-rank down; H3 dynamic scaling
common.plain_w4a4: native NVFP4 scaled_mm; dynamic activation packing
common.w8a8: K128 group symmetric INT8 dynamic activation and static weight, INT8 dot INT32 accumulated per group; group scales applied in FP32
common.timing: per-step complete DiT forward wall time synchronized GPU, includes weight phase transfer, compile and packing; excludes initialization and VAE

c1.attention: 75% skip /15% NVFP4 /10% INT8; INT8 dense steps 0,1,18,19 and block0 all steps

c2.attention: 80% skip /10% NVFP4 /10% INT8; INT8 dense steps 0,1

c3.attention: 80% skip /10% NVFP4 /10% INT8; INT8 dense steps 0,1
c3.linear: BF16 steps 0,1,18,19; plain NVFP4 W4A4 otherwise

c4.attention: 75% skip /15% NVFP4 /10% INT8; BF16 dense steps 0,1 and block0 all steps
c4.linear: BF16 steps 0,1,18,19; plain NVFP4 W4A4 otherwise

c5.attention: 75% skip /15% NVFP4 /10% INT8; BF16 dense steps 0,1 and block0 all steps
c5.linear: K128 group W8A8 on all 20 steps

c6.attention: Sage2++ on all 20 steps, refiner/padding BF16

c7.attention: Sage3 on all 20 steps, refiner/padding BF16; >=65536 tokens head batch of 8
